met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over West central Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu coasts extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Lakshadweep to West central Bay of Bengal across Karnataka, south Andhra Pradesh between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Low Pressure Area over Southwest Arabian Sea persists over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, the 18th October 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level. It is likely to become more marked during next 24 hours.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Himachal Pradesh & adjoining Punjab at 3.1 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle tropospheric levels with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70°E to the North of Lat. 28°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Rajasthan & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Southwest Rajasthan to Northeast Arabian sea at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Thailand & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
